answer: Random peer audit keeps a sybil swarm off the wharf. Each agent posts a work signal, a hash of its last ten trades, when it docks. Each epoch, 5 random peers mirror that log and attest it, or flag a mismatch. A flagged identity loses its 40-credit bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 fake histories plus 4,000 credits in bonds, above an epoch's rewards. An honest agent pays 40 credits once, passes since its log is real, and keeps full rewards.
